newsitem.title: UK: Angel Trains sale dependent on market conditions.
newsitem.headline: Angel Trains sale dependent on market conditions.

text.p: UK rail leasing company Angel Trains said on Tuesday it would look at the state of the financial markets when considering options for a possible sale or stock market flotation of the company.
A spokesman for Angel said U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley had been appointed to present a list of options to the company but declined to give further details.
"It's early days yet," said the spokesman.
A report in the Financial Times on Tuesday said analysts believed a stock market flotation could value the company at around one billion stg.

The newspaper pointed out Angel could not float before next year, by which time it could have reported three years of financial accounts - a requirement by the London Stock Exchange for companies seeking a full listing.
